gitCommit.subject: fix(site): a one-row phone header (languages move into the menu); the social image and icons
gitCommit.body:
fix(site): a one-row phone header (languages move into the menu); the social image and icons

The browser checks found sideways scroll on every page at 375 and 320 px: the bar carried the mark, three languages, Sign in and Menu. On a phone the languages now live in the menu with the navigation; below 360 px the mark shows without its name (the link keeps its accessible name). The check now names what overflows. The social preview image and PNG icons are the text treatment rendered in CI (scripts/brand-assets.mjs), not a new logo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
